name: se-semantic-graph
description: 把项目全知识域（客户画像/需求/成本/架构/分层/模块运行逻辑/历史决策）落进 axolotl 图库，修 bug/加功能/重构时沿跨域语义边定向查询精确上下文，根治上下文爆炸与注意力分散。替代把整个项目塞进 prompt 硬扛。
description_zh: 把项目全知识域（客户画像/需求/成本/架构/分层/模块运行逻辑/历史决策）落进 axolotl 图库，修 bug/加功能/重构时沿跨域语义边定向查询精确上下文，根治上下文爆炸与注意力分散。
description_en: Stores the full software-engineering knowledge space (customer persona / requirements / cost / architecture / layering / module runtime logic / historical decisions) into the axolotl graph database, and does directed traversal along cross-domain semantic edges to fetch exact context when fixing bugs, adding features, or refactoring — curing context explosion and attention scattering. Instead of cramming the whole project into the prompt.
author: Sai
